candidate: prior funding-window edge raid, failed auction and MSS reversal

week_selection.method: candidate-specific deterministic Monday selection from BTC weeks unused by prior candidate gates

market_representation.event_clock: causal daily equal-notional clock selected from the immediately preceding completed UTC day
market_representation.directional_change_threshold: 40 bps existing economically derived intrinsic-time detector

scenario.source: prior funding-window high or low is raided during the next funding window
scenario.failed_auction: completed event closes back inside the raided edge with aggressive-flow sign toward the opposite edge
scenario.primary_confirmation: aligned-flow close crosses the nearest opposing directional-change pivot confirmed inside the active funding window
scenario.entry: market bracket on first official venue trade strictly after completed MSS
scenario.target: opposite edge of the immediately completed funding window, provided it was not already consumed
scenario.invalidation: full raid-to-MSS path extreme plus one 7-bp side-cost buffer
scenario.expiry: end of the active eight-hour funding window

control.difference: enter immediately after failed-auction re-entry without MSS on the identical source range and event stream

execution.market_data: official Binance Vision USD-M aggregate trades converted one-for-one to TradeTick
